usedFor: ManyContacts captures new conversations, and HubSpot tracks the sale when “New Contact” runs “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in ManyContacts, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Every new contact opens a deal, so a sales owner sees the chat lead in HubSpot.

watchOut: “New Contact” is polling, so “Create Deal” runs after a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
